title: Reduced order model for parametric Boltzmann equation and its application to inverse problems
summary: The Boltzmann equation plays an important role in modeling mesoscopic behavior in a wide range of scientific and engineering applications. However, its numerical solution is computationally expensive due to the high dimensionality of the model and the nonlinear nonlocal collision operator, especially for steady-state problems that require iterative solvers. This cost becomes prohibitive for inverse problems, where the induced optimization problem requires repeated forward solves.
